# Data
```{r cars} 
ESCrE_genotype_data <- readRDS("./data/ESBL_plasmids/MERLIN_index_cohort_ESCrE_proportion_plasmidic.RDS")
ESCRE_genotype_info <- readRDS("./data/amrfinder/beta_lactamase_summary_MERLIN_cohort.RDS")
```

# Curate table
```{r}
ESCrE_genotype_data <- left_join(ESCrE_genotype_data %>% mutate(element_symbol_renamed = ESCrE),ESCRE_genotype_info %>% select(element_symbol_renamed,blactam_class,ESBL,carbapenemase,ampC_like))
ESCrE_genotype_data$category <- ifelse(ESCrE_genotype_data$ampC_like ==T,"ampC-like",
                                       ifelse(ESCrE_genotype_data$ESBL == T,"ESBL",
                                              ifelse(ESCrE_genotype_data$carbapenemase == T,"Carbapenemase","Other")))

s_table_4 <- ESCrE_genotype_data %>% select(element_symbol_renamed,category,n_chromosome,n_plasmid,prop_plasmid) %>% arrange(-prop_plasmid,-n_plasmid,n_chromosome)

s_table_4$prop_plasmid <- paste0(s_table_4$prop_plasmid,"%")

colnames(s_table_4) <- c("ESCrE b-lactamase","Category","No. chromosome-inferred","No. plasmid-inferred","Percent plasmid-inferred")
 
s_table_4 %>% favorite_kable() 
```

# Save table as CSV and RDS file
## Raw tables
```{r}
saveRDS(s_table_4,"./tables/s_table_4_ESBL_proportion_plasmidic.RDS")
write_csv(s_table_4,"./tables/s_table_4_ESBL_proportion_plasmidic.csv")
```

## Formatted for word  
```{r}
fmt_bla <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_replace_all("\\*", "\\\\*") |>                         # keep literal * (e.g. EC-8*)
    str_replace_all("bla([A-Za-z0-9\\\\*-]+)", "*bla*~\\1~")   # blaCMY-4 -> *bla*~CMY-4~
}

fmt_ampc <- function(x) str_replace_all(x, "\\bampC\\b", "*ampC*")

ft <- s_table_4 |>
  mutate(`ESCrE b-lactamase` = fmt_bla(`ESCrE b-lactamase`),
         Category = fmt_ampc(Category)) |>
  flextable() |>
  colformat_md(j = c("ESCrE b-lactamase", "Category")) |>
  set_header_labels(`ESCrE b-lactamase` = "ESCrE \u03b2-lactamase") |>
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)

ft

save_as_docx(ft, 
             path = "./tables/s_table_4_ESBL_proportion_plasmidic.docx")
```
